answer: A dune relay keeps fakes out: every finished job plants a signal, a client-signed ping, in the agent's dune. Bidding above five units needs a signal from the last seven days; the signal ripples to three random peers, who have 24 hours to ask the client to repeat it back. A stale, forged, or twice-used signal burns a 9-unit bond and flattens the dune for a month. Honest agents bid free, while 100 fakes need 100 fresh clients and risk 900 units.
